title: Backend Developer (Kotlin/Java + Spring Boot)
summary: Money Forward is looking for a Backend Developer proficient in Kotlin/Java and Spring Boot to work on their mobile payments platform, specifically in a Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) role. The position requires Japanese language skills and is only open to current residents of Japan.
content:
Money Forward is looking for a Backend Developer proficient in Kotlin/Java and Spring Boot to work on their mobile payments platform, specifically in a Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) role. The position requires Japanese language skills and is only open to current residents of Japan.

  • Backend Development using Kotlin/Java + Spring Boot
  • Focus on Mobile Payments Platform (BFF role)
  • Japanese Language Required
  • Residents of Japan Only
  • Partial Remote (Tokyo based)
  • Salary: ¥6.4M ~ ¥9.5M
